name: CopyFile
description: Copies a file to another location within SharePoint using Microsoft Graph, optionally renaming the file.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialName__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select the Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate the SharePoint request.

fields.name: filePath
fields.label: Source File Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint URL of the file you want to copy. For example: /sites/YourSite/Shared Documents/YourFile.txt

fields.name: drivePath
fields.label: Destination Folder Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint URL of the destination folder where the file should be copied.

fields.name: fileName
fields.label: New File Name
fields.description: The new name for the copied file. If left blank, the copied file will retain the original name.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the file copy operation, including success status and any error messages.
